objectives.description: Use Igbo greetings, expressions of courtesy, and formulaic exchanges in everyday conversations
Perform oral drills to master correct Igbo sounds, tones, and pronunciation patterns
Carry out simple dialogues and role plays on familiar topics in Igbo
Identify and recite Igbo proverbs, olu-olu (praise poetry), and explain their meanings
Listen to and retell Igbo folktales, riddles, and oral narratives with comprehension
Identify letters, vowels, consonants, and tonal marks of the Igbo orthography and write them correctly
Construct simple, compound, and complex sentences in Igbo using correct grammar and syntax
Identify and use Igbo parts of speech (nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives) in sentences
Express time, numbers, days of the week, and months in Igbo correctly
Apply tonal marks and diacritical symbols specific to Igbo writing conventions
Read simple Igbo texts aloud with correct pronunciation, fluency, and expression
Identify main ideas and supporting details in Igbo reading passages
Write simple compositions, descriptions, and narratives in Igbo using appropriate vocabulary
Build Igbo vocabulary on familiar topics including home, school, community, and the environment
Write letters, messages, and short notes in Igbo using appropriate register and format
Identify and interpret Igbo poems, songs, and praise poetry in Igbo
Read and analyse Igbo drama texts identifying plot, characters, and themes
Describe the cultural significance of Igbo oral traditions including olu-olu (praise poetry) and riddles
Appreciate the role of Igbo language in preserving Nigerian cultural identity and heritage
